scope: Saved frozen validation/test predictions only; no CTR training or inference
timing: User-specified after aggregate test reporting; fixed before new grouped test results, bootstrap intervals and calibration results. Not retrospective first-test preregistration.

bootstrap.unit: raw user ID; draw U users with replacement from U observed test users; every exposure of each user receives that user's integer multiplicity
bootstrap.pairing: Identical user multiplicities across all 13 distinct saved predictors and all five comparisons per replicate
bootstrap.estimand: Arithmetic mean of per-training-seed metric differences, not metric of averaged predictions. Three trained residual seeds fixed, never resampled; zero predictor included once and referenced for each seed.
bootstrap.p_value: Two-sided centered bootstrap: (1 + count(abs(delta_boot - delta_observed) >= abs(delta_observed))) / (B + 1); approximate sampling test, not exact randomization
bootstrap.holm: Across the two primary comparisons separately for each metric; additionally across all four primary AUC/LogLoss hypotheses as a stricter joint primary family
bootstrap.invalid: Require 1000 finite valid replicates; stop rather than silently discard insufficient replicates
bootstrap.algorithm: Exact weighted rank/tie metrics with one global sort per predictor, not histogram approximation; GAUC uses user AUC times resampled impression count among eligible users
bootstrap.rng: mt19937_64 initialized with base seed + replicate index; exactly U uniform integer draws per replicate; deterministic across thread count

groups.history_length_definition: Retained length min(raw_length,20); 20 includes raw length exactly 20 or greater
groups.category_overlap: Current raw candidate category occurs in the target user's matched retained last-20 history; same groups for every model; compare raw categories to avoid UNKNOWN-index collisions; empty history => false
groups.cold_start: Existing train-only raw user/ad encoder vocabularies, four quadrants
groups.selection: Diagnostic only; no group-specific tuning or fallback changes

calibration.selection: Validation impression-ID uint64 multiplicative hash modulo 5; 80% fit, 20% method selection by LogLoss; choose between Platt/isotonic regardless of raw baseline; refit selected method on all validation
calibration.conditions: Four sequence conditions x three seeds, zero once = 13 calibrators
calibration.application: Transform saved test probabilities only; keep every selected calibrator regardless of test outcome
calibration.reporting: Raw/calibrated overall and identical cold-start/history-length groups; full-validation calibrated metrics explicitly in-sample
calibration.ece: Shared evaluator 10 equal-count bins for comparable reports; legacy calibrator selection helper retains its 20 equal-width ECE diagnostics; LogLoss chooses method

uncertainty: Bootstrap is user-sampling uncertainty conditional on fixed models/test day. Seed mean/std is separate training-randomness variation conditional on the one frozen DeepFM. Zero has no independent training seeds.
strong_baseline_context: Read historical LR/LightGBM test reports descriptively; no new pairwise significance claim outside five frozen comparisons
